requirements.statement: The browser MUST render versioned immutable snapshots and MUST NOT invent or silently reinterpret physical values.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: A contract change MUST version and update its schema, producers, consumers, fixtures, semantic validators, and compatibility tests in the same pull request.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Scientific claims MUST state provenance, calibration, uncertainty, accuracy scope, and operational limits; normalized values MUST NOT be presented as calibrated units.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Observed or cached data MUST retain source, time, freshness, quality, and finite-value evidence, and degraded data MUST fail closed or remain visibly degraded.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Committed generated data and reference simulations MUST be reproducible, and the reference snapshot MUST remain byte-identical across supported CI operating systems.
ci_gates: CI / Engine determinism (cross-OS byte compare + schema)

requirements.statement: The initial view MUST expose the primary learning task and current system state while advanced, rare, or research controls remain clearly labelled and disclosed on request.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Interactive controls MUST have accessible names, keyboard-equivalent operation, visible focus, and non-canvas alternatives for material information.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Asynchronous operations, provider changes, errors, and degraded modes MUST provide visible status, preserve user control, and offer a recovery or fallback path.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Observer computation MUST remain on-device by default, and a remote provider MUST require configuration and explicit consent before location and time are transmitted.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Every behavior change MUST include tests at the lowest useful layer and regression coverage for the user-visible or contract boundary it can break.
CI MUST enforce at least 90 percent line coverage for Rust, Python, and the denominator-complete hand-written web runtime, plus at least 90 percent Node line, branch, and function coverage.
Browser CI MUST validate WebGL behavior and semantic image properties for Sun colour, Earth visibility, and camera orbit continuity, and retain failure evidence.
ci_gates: CI / Web, provider, and browser validation

requirements.statement: Third-party actions MUST be commit-SHA pinned, workflows MUST use least-privilege permissions, and production MUST deploy only the exact successful master CI SHA.
A change MUST update the governing specification, requirement links, implementation plan, operator instructions, and user documentation when their claims or commands change.
CI and production dependencies MUST be lockfile-controlled or immutable-SHA pinned, and automated dependency update review MUST be configured for each package ecosystem in use.
A release MUST preserve test, coverage, deterministic snapshot, and browser visual evidence sufficient to identify the tested commit and reproduce a failure.
ci_gates: CI / Engine determinism (cross-OS byte compare + schema)
